caption: Each Kubeflow subproject owns one stage of the ML lifecycle, and Pipelines strings the stages together into a repeatable, tracked run.
alt: A data scientist works in Notebooks or Workspaces and submits work. Kubeflow Pipelines orchestrates the stages: Trainer runs distributed training as a TrainJob, Katib searches hyperparameters by launching many trials, and the resulting model version is registered in Kubeflow Hub's Model Registry. KServe reads the registered model artifact from storage and serves it as an InferenceService.
